title_zh: 先确认周末会场开放条件

scenario.label_zh: 先确认会场开放条件再发送邀请
scenario.goal_zh: 识别周末进场的未经确认假设并约定核实后再发邀请

context_zh: 同事 Theo 与 Priya 准备周六的工作坊，手头只有平日使用会场的经验。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: The building was open when I visited yesterday. Presumably we can get in on Saturday too.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: I wouldn't presume that. Yesterday was a working day.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: True. It would be problematic if everyone arrived and found the doors locked.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Let's ask the venue contact about weekend access before sending the invitations.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: I'll call now and ask who opens the building and at what time.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll hold the invitation email until we have an answer.
